title: The daily tape · 19 August 2026
description: Daily tape · 19 Aug 2026. Country signals and sourced silicon prints. Labeled terms only — no invented 7-day moves.
og_kicker: Country conversion signals and sourced silicon prints.
lede: The Silicon Tape did not tick overnight: Lambda H100 $3.99 and B200 $6.69, CoreWeave H100 $6.16 / H200 $6.31 / B200 $8.60, Crusoe H100 $3.90 / H200 $4.29, DigitalOcean H100 $4.41 / 12m $3.26 — all unchanged vs 18 Aug. The new conversion print is policy: Beijing is letting limited H200 batches land (ByteDance and Tencent ~10k each) and steering the rest to Hong Kong. PUCT meets tomorrow on the Texas audit.

countries.name: China
countries.note: FT via Business Standard (19 Aug 2026): ByteDance and Tencent each ~10,000 H200s; Beijing steering most volume to Hong Kong. 75k vs 100k per-customer US cap unresolved. Blackwell still banned. Source: FT / Business Standard.

countries.name: United States
countries.note: NVIDIA 8-K (17 Aug 2026): residual-value guaranties on PORTS-Pike, ~4.25 IT-GW, OpenAI 20-year lease, $105B cap. Conversion as land-power-shell finance. Source: SEC.
